# Walk In Tubs With Jets

> WalkInTubsWithJets.com is an Aging Safely Baths resource about walk-in tubs with air jets, water (whirlpool) jets and combination systems. It offers free, working tools (jet chooser, operating cost calculator, amp checker, fill and drain timeline, cleaning schedule maker, bath thermometer check) and calm, no-obligation quotes. Aging Safely Baths is BBB accredited, an authorized Ella's Bubbles dealer, and also offers Hydro Dimensions, Bestbath (including RANE by Bestbath) and Meditub. Phone 1-888-779-2284 (BATH). Prices are quoted per home.

## Pages

- [Walk-in tubs with jets](https://walkintubswithjets.com/): Overview of air, whirlpool and combination jet systems, safety features, VA grant information, installation process, guides and tools, and FAQs.
- [Air jets vs water jets](https://walkintubswithjets.com/air-vs-water-jets/): How each jet system works, a 6-question jet chooser, side-by-side table (feel, bath salts, cleaning, power draw) and FAQs.
- [Walk-in tub operating cost calculator](https://walkintubswithjets.com/walk-in-tub-operating-cost/): Cost per bath, month and year from your electric rate, pump/blower/heater watts and hot-water use, with the formula shown and a worked example. Finding: heating the fill water, not the jets, is most of the running cost.
- [How to clean walk-in tub jets](https://walkintubswithjets.com/how-to-clean-walk-in-tub-jets/): Water-jet flush steps, air-jet care, door seal and drain care, a printable cleaning schedule maker and a troubleshooting table (black flakes, foam, smell).
- [Walk-in tub electrical requirements](https://walkintubswithjets.com/walk-in-tub-electrical-requirements/): NEC 680 Part VII basics (individual branch circuit, accessible GFCI), what manufacturer manuals require, an amp checker and a printable electrician checklist.
- [Walk-in tub fill and drain time](https://walkintubswithjets.com/walk-in-tub-fill-and-drain-time/): Typical fill (5-10 min) and drain (6-15 min standard, 2-4 min fast drain) times, a bucket test and bath timeline calculator, and tips for staying warm.
- [Jetted walk-in tubs and arthritis](https://walkintubswithjets.com/jetted-walk-in-tub-arthritis/): Warm-water temperature range (92-100 F), matching jets to sore areas, a shopping checklist for stiff hands, who should ask a doctor first, and a first-week routine.
- [Free quote](https://walkintubswithjets.com/free-quote/): Quote request form, what happens next, what to have ready, brands offered and the no-pressure promise.

## Key facts

- Phone: 1-888-779-2284 (BATH).
- BBB accredited: https://www.bbb.org/us/co/denver/profile/walk-in-tubs/aging-safely-walk-in-tubs-1296-90145069/
- Serving families with safer bathing since 2012; installation available nationwide in the U.S., supply-only shipping to Canada.
- Brands: Ella's Bubbles (authorized dealer), Hydro Dimensions, Bestbath (including RANE by Bestbath), Meditub.
